title: Brigadeiro
description: Brigadeiro is a dish from Brazil featuring sweetened condensed milk. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used. Ordinary sugar sprinkles replace traditional chocolate vermicelli sprinkles.

steps.instruction: Simmer the liquid and flavorings uncovered for about 14 minutes until reduced and concentrated.
Refrigerate the prepared mixture for about 50 minutes, cooling perishable foods promptly and never holding cooked rice warm at room temperature.
Shape, press or roll the prepared dough or mixture into portions appropriate to this dish.
Roll the chilled chocolate mixture into small balls and coat with edible confectionery sprinkles without heating again.
